title: The voyage to England, poker and not drinking
summary: On the crossing the band played poker all night while Duke drank brandy and champagne; Cootie did not drink until he had his band.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: I think when the band went to England, that was prior to those numbers, I think.

Well, Cootie, what do you remember about that? I know that Ellington always swore he'd never cross the ocean. And then they got him fixed up where he had to go. I know he stayed high on brandy and champagne or something, all the way. Do you remember?
Yeah. We used to play cards all night long. Poker.
Yeah. He'd sit up, and he'd be drinking brandy and champagne. In those days I wasn't drinking.
No kidding. Did you -- you mean from the very beginning you didn't drink? When you were a kid, right on?
No. I didn't drink until I got my band.
So you and Tricky hung out together, but you didn't drink?
We didn't exactly hang out together.
Oh. It was more the musical thing.
And I didn't drink then, during that time.
No. I guess he didn't really drink much either, did he?
No. Johnny and Barney. I don't recall anyone in there but Sonny, and who else? And Tricky.
Oh. He didn't drink either, huh?
Oh. Well, Duke used to drink.
Yeah. Yeah. Well, that's quite unusual isn't it?
Or it would look unusual today, anyway.
Well -- No, I didn't drink at all until I got my band.
